bullets: ATTENTION: Please press and hold for 0.5-2 seconds to turn on the air pump, and hold for 2 seconds to turn it off. The air pump cannot be powered on while charging. Please unplug the power cable before turning it on. This air pump is not suitable for SUP!!! Please don't use it to inflate SUP, balloon, sports balls, car tires, or bicycles

2X FASTER INFLATION & DEFLATION: The 0.65 PSI(4.5 kPa) air pressure and 13 CFM(360 L/min) wind speed allow ETENWOLF AIR 3 to achieve rapid inflation or deflation, it can inflate an air mattress in just 1 minute and deflate it in 40 seconds

2X LARGER BATTERY CAPACITY: With 2600 mAh Lithium Battery, ETENWOLF AIR 3 can inflate up to sixteen sleeping pads or four inflatable swimming pools(58''*13") on full charge. AIR 3 is also compatible with any Type-C quick charger and can be charged much quicker
AS TINY AS AN EGG: ETENWOLF AIR 3 portable air pump is super mini and lightweight, it also has a hook to be attached to the backpack or put in your pocket

600 LUMENS CAMPING LIGHT: Beyond an air mattress pump, AIR 3 has much brighter LED Light, it offers three modes for different purposes, soft light of 60 Lumens, reading light of 200 Lumens and outdoor light of 600 Lumens

FIVE NOZZLES & DIVERSE USES: Comes with five nozzles, AIR 3 is suitable for most inflatable products, such as air mattresses, pool floats, vacuum storage bags, inflatable beds, sleeping pads, swimming rings, inflatable furniture and other inflatable toys
